how_it_works.title: How it works ?
how_it_works.description: Transforming your restaurant's menu into a digital experience is fast 🚀

steps.h: Get in touch with our sales team
steps.p: Contact us via our website, phone, or email. We'll discuss your needs, finalize the subscription details, and you'll send us high-quality photos of your physical menu. [[(Contact informations bellow 👇)]]

Our team will digitize your menu, ensuring every detail is captured accurately and attractively for your customers.
[[Note! Your menu will be available in 3 languages: Arabic, English, and French.]]

steps.h: Printing and delivery of custom QR codes
steps.p: We design a custom QR code with your branding, print it on high-quality, waterproof stickers, and deliver them to your restaurant. Your customers can then scan the QR code to instantly access the menu on their phones.
